_comment: scripts/lint/orphan_header_check.py: engine/godot-src headers included by nothing outside tests/ and their own unit that are NOT staged policy code. Each entry names why it has no include consumer. The 2026-08-25 census debt was burned down on 2026-08-27 (threedi_compare moved to tests/threedi/, terrain/types.h deleted, serializing_sink.h STAGED with its owner named); never grow this list without a reason that names the consumer.

allow.engine/base/resource_index/file_kind.h: The typed kinds and their loader facts (the names that give a kind, its archive, its place under an expansion, its line reader), which the editor's asset kinds read their facts from (engine/editor/assets/asset_kind.h, asset_kinds.cpp, asset_type_registry.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.engine/formats/fnt/fnt_sheet.h: A glyph sheet made into a bitmap font, which the editor's font import makes a font set's .fnt with (engine/editor/import/font_import.cpp). Its include consumers are the OpenNova Editor's, on the editor trunk (PR #665); delete this entry when the editor lands.
allow.godot/src/register_types.h: The GDExtension entry-point declaration: consumed by its own register_types.cpp plus the .gdextension config's entry_symbol resolution at load time - the linker/loader is the consumer, not an #include.
